Grandmaster Vole is the overseer and announcer of the Theater of Pain in Maldraxxus. No one in the Shadowlands loves combat sport more than Vole, and he relays his extreme enthusiasm and gusto through his commentary. During the initial phase of the Maldraxxus storyline, he is located within the arena's northernmost barrack and sends adventurers to fight in the arena's Contest of Conquest after mistaking them for gladiators. Vole serves as the announcer for the Theater of Pain dungeon, providing commentary on the heroes as they battle the champions of the three corrupt houses of Maldraxxus. The Great Glorious Alliance is an alternate version of the Alliance from the Warlands, a timeline in which there was never peace between the Horde and Alliance, led by High King Varian Wrynn. The Great Glorious Alliance presumably had a similar history to the Alliance, in which they fought two wars against the Horde before defeating them and placing them into the Internment camps. However, the aftermath left fractures within the Alliance as many found the peace to be miserable and loathsome and felt that the orcs should have just been executed. The Great Royal Sword (or the "blade of Stormwind") was a massive, two-handed runeblade pledged to defend the Kingdom of Stormwind, formerly wielded by Anduin Lothar. It was a massive, rune-etched glittering blade, with a huge and jeweled crosspiece. Despite the size and weight of the weapon, Lothar wielded it one-handed alongside a lion-head shield. During his combat with the Warchief of the Horde Orgrim Doomhammer, the sword was broken by the Doomhammer, and Lothar was defeated. The blade fell from his dead grasp, though it was soon taken up by Lothar's lieutenant, the young paladin Turalyon, who used it in turn to defeat Orgrim and rally the remaining Alliance forces to victory. The Great Vault is an enchanted vault that stores many remarkable artifacts, located in the Valdrakken Treasury Hoard of Valdrakken. Overseen by Evantkis, it serves as a weekly reward system. Players are introduced to it shortly after reaching max level during the quest The Great Vault. First introduced in , the Great Vault of Oribos was described as a massive relic of the First Ones, where it was overseen by Caretaker Kah-Toll, with Ko'tul running Attendant's Token of Merit exchange. The Great Vault interface can be accessed from the vaults in Oribos or Valdrakken and from the Mythic+ Dungeons tab of the Group Finder.
The Greataxe of Unrelenting Pursuit drops from Valfir the Unrelenting in the Mistveil Tangle in Ardenweald.
Greatstaff of the Lichsworn is sold by Su Zettai in the Seat of the Primus for after reaching Renown (Shadowlands) 37.

The Greater Greedstone is found at the Crypt of the Forgotten in Revendreth. Interacting with it will grant the buff Path of Greed causing a number of platforms to appear. Navigate them successfully within a minute to reach Greed's Desire.
